summary: Master the role of central banks in financial inclusion. Learn to design NFIS, regulate Fintech, and implement CBDCs for inclusive growth. Enroll today.
lede: Central bank financial inclusion training examines how policy can widen access while supporting financial stability and integrity. It is for policy analysts, supervisors and payment-system regulators who develop inclusion strategies, assess access data, oversee digital payment services and design proportionate rules and consumer protections.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for professionals tasked with bridging the gap between financial stability and universal access within the regulatory environment.
modules: Foundations of Central Bank Inclusion Policy
Digital Financial Services and Payment Systems
Central Bank Digital Currencies and Inclusion
prerequisites: Participants should have a minimum of 3 years of experience in central banking, financial regulation, or economic policy. Familiarity with basic financial stability concepts and payment system fundamentals is recommended. No prior experience with specific inclusion frameworks is required, though a working knowledge of the Basel Committee standards is beneficial.
